requirements.text: Automated reminders should be sent out 24 hours and 1 hour before appointments via SMS and email
Customers should be able to book appointments online anytime, choosing service, barber, and time slot
Each barber should have control over their own availability through a user-friendly interface
Daily and weekly booking summaries should include total bookings, cancellations, no-shows, peak times, and customer feedback
The system must comply with data protection laws for managing customer personal data
There should be a cancellation policy requiring a minimum of 24 hours' notice, with a one-time grace period for first-time customers
The solution needs to be cost-effective for implementation and maintenance
Booking interface should display a list of services offered and allow customers to see barber specialties
Barbers should be able to block off specific times for training or personal appointments
The booking system must provide real-time updates when barbers change their availability
